title: Unit 24 Consolidation: Research, Freedom and Discovery
goal: I can use the words for research method, proof and discovery.
I can use method adverbs, -va/-ve chains and *míg … addig* when writing about research.
I can state an aim with *céljából* or *végett* and judge the size of a discovery.
